paragraphs.text: The Cinder Marsh was a nasty area of the plane of Rath .

The Cinder Marsh was where the Stronghold ’s furnaces were exhausted, a nasty mix of sludge and ash. It heaved like something alive, and from time to time, a sparkling shower sprayed across its surface. The sludge was punctuated by chimney-like growths that occasionally spouted ash and gobbets of molten metal - exhaust vents. Some things lived there, but they were crawling beasts. They were not dangerous as long as one could keep off the ground. The exhaust vents, a few of them wide enough to admit the Skyship Weatherlight , allowed entry into the Hub, where the Stronghold lay.

In 4204 AR, the Skyship Weatherlight passed through the Cinder Marsh on the way to the Stronghold . They entered one of the large, inactive exhaust vents without incident and lowered themselves into the bowels of the ground below. There, the slivers swarmed them.
During the Rathi Overlay , Cinder Marsh was shifted to Dominaria , but it is not known where it ended up or if it was destroyed in the process.
